run_filter_pdb_test_mmcifs_cli: run the CLI script to filter mmCIF files for the AlphaFold 3 PDB evaluation dataset
filter_experiment_type: filter an mmCIF object based on experiment type, returning true if it passes the criteria
prefilter_target: pre-filter an mmCIF target by release date, experiment type, resolution, and token count
filter_structure_with_timeout: filter a single mmCIF structure file with a timeout and write the filtered output
filter_structure: filter a single mmCIF structure file with error handling and cleanup on failure
